verdict.rationale: Dependent visas are a fair question for an immigration law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence lists principal visas (O-1, H-1B, L-1, E-3, TN) and family sponsorship by US citizens, but it never mentions O-3, H-4, L-2 or other derivative visas for spouses and children, or dependent work authorization. Family sponsorship by citizens is a different service and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service
